description: This file contains unit tests for the LoanCOBEnabledCondition class, verifying its behavior based on environment property values related to loan close of business (COB) enabling.

classes.name: LoanCOBEnabledConditionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the LoanCOBEnabledCondition class's matching logic based on environment property values.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the environment mock before each test, setting up the environment dependency for the condition.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnFalseWhenLoanCobIsDisabled
methods.description: Tests that the condition returns false when the environment property 'fineract.job.loan-cob-enabled' is set to 'false'.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnTrueWhenLoanCobIsEnabled
methods.description: Tests that the condition returns true when the environment property 'fineract.job.loan-cob-enabled' is set to 'true'.
